scientific_integrity: Established expansion and single-window full counting statistics are credited to Mesquita et al.; independent mathematical audit and external priority verification have not been performed; general-mixture implicit coverage remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Claims refer to leading-order large-particle self-similar Thomas–Fermi hydrodynamics, not finite-particle quantum correlations; no unique crossover rate is established; shell and core radii and trap frequency remain fixed during asymptotics.
title: A reset-rate sign reversal in core–shell correlations of an expanding Thomas–Fermi condensate
